question:
A sensitive electrometer is placed at the center of a closed, thin-walled hollow metallic box (the box is insulated from ground). Consider two situations:
(I) Strong external static charges are brought near the box, but nothing is placed inside it.
(II) A small charged bead is suspended inside the cavity, away from the walls.
What is the electric field at the electrometer in each case?
